name: Chromatic Dragon’s Treachery
body:
You have acquired the treacherous abilities of the chromatic dragons whose blood flows through your veins.

Prerequisite(s): 1st-level dragon disciple, must have a chromatic dragon bloodline

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Bluff and Intimidate checks. In addition, once per day per three dragon disciple levels you possess, you are able to take 10 on a Bluff or Intimidate check.
